title: A THICK DARKNESS
theme: Egypt’s thick darkness illustrates life without spiritual light, knowledge, joy, and love.
proposition: We must turn from spiritual darkness to the light, knowledge, joy, and love found in God.

outline.heading: The darkness is thickest where there is no light.
The darkness is thickest where there is no knowledge.
The darkness is thickest where there is no joy.
The darkness is thickest where there is no love.

legacyImport.contentPreservation: Original Josh Hetrick legacy sermon preserved unchanged.
